subject: C5 pre-build audit: C4 blockers fixed in source; stale artifacts + uncommitted formats are the gates
body:
C4->C5 re-audit 175a718..3415864 (+uncommitted render.c/.h), read-only, no builds.
FIXED in source: newTextureViewWithPixelFormat: render_encoder.inc:252-263; setThreadgroupMemoryLength compute_frontend.m:1865 (max 32768, %16); NoCopy/linearTexture/resourceGroup/encodeCacheHint exist (compute_frontend.m:1053,1104,1060,1065) but NoCopy+linear return nil (trace only), safe only because deviceLinearReadOnlyTextureAlignmentBytes stays 0; compute inert pipelines runtime_pipeline.inc:49-135,144-171 (backboardd only); render nils now fall into inert tail render_pipeline.inc:2038 and :2012; same-texture-two-attachments refusal restored nord2_render_pass.inc:49 (command invalidated, inert encoder, never nil).
RANKED remaining (backboardd):
1 STALE ARTIFACTS: iOS Rust .a 00:47 lacks native_dispatch_tg (strong ref runtime_pipeline.inc:186), Mali .a/frontend/bundle 00:51 predate mali_compute_compiler.c 01:07, runtime_pipeline.inc 01:12, compute_frontend.m 01:35, render.c 02:47. Need full rebuild order rust, mali, frontend objs, link; strict link will catch only Rust.
2 UNCOMMITTED nord2_metal_render.c/.h (textures T2 formats): n2r_bpp now admits 25,30,55,65,90,94,110,125; reaches render_pass/pipeline admission process-wide (also SpringBoard), host-only, no HW. Commit or exclude before C5; build-identity hashes working tree and ignores -D flags, so safe/compositor binaries are indistinguishable by identity: record NORD2_FRONTEND_DEFINES in receipt.
3 Selector audit (95) is hand-curated by integration (delta6_frontend_audit.inc), not extracted from the QuartzCore binary: proves old blockers only. Tegu textures/encoders are NSObject-based: any other CA selector is an abort. Need MTL-selector extraction from the real Mach-O.
4 newFunctionWithName/specialize nil (library_frontend.inc:233,309) tested for 2 of all QuartzCore functions; need all-function loop incl compute_apl, compute_apl_fast, sum_apl_and_compute_dimming_factor (exist in metallib).
5 Inert compute leaves APL/dimming output buffers unwritten: no crash, possible wrong dimming.
6 Sampler nil (sampler_state.inc:213-216) depends on weak compile_compute_v2 enabling exact factory (compute_frontend.m:923); newBufferWithLength options!=0 still nil (:1067); async/options pipeline selectors absent.
C5-safe vs C3/C4-safe: inert code compiled out; deltas process-wide: maxThreadgroupMemoryLength 0->32768 (MPS path changes), blit/texture-view additions, item 2 formats. C4 maxColorAttachments=4 persists.
